lines.zh: 我的关节一格一格地响。
lines.en: My joints click along, one notch at a time.

lines.zh: 两条细腿撑着我往前走。
lines.en: Two thin legs carry me forward.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地面留下小圆坑。
lines.en: My steps leave little round dents.
My sensors never stop sweeping.
I keep my center low and move steadily.
My boots land with a crisp sound.
I sidestep out from behind cover.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，机体却很大声。
lines.en: I try to be quiet, but this chassis is loud.
I patrol the edge of this ground.
I measure the distance of every step.

lines.zh: 我的引擎在低速下嗡嗡响。
lines.en: My engine hums at low speed.

lines.zh: 我转身时，腰先动，头后动。
lines.en: When I turn, my hips go first, then my head.

lines.zh: 我给自己的路线做了标记。
lines.en: I've marked out my own route.
I stand, and the fan turns at my back.
My indicator light pulses on and off.

lines.zh: 我这台小家伙还没上油。
lines.en: This little frame of mine needs oil.
I turn my head to its full range.
There's dust on my lens.
I crouch slightly in place.

lines.zh: 冷却管里传出细细的响。
lines.en: A thin hiss comes from my coolant line.
I'm counting the sounds around me.
I have no target at the moment.

lines.zh: 我把自己当成一台机器。
lines.en: I treat myself as one machine.
Scan complete. You are alive.

lines.zh: 我的镜头正对着你的脸。
lines.en: My lens is pointed at your face.
I've recorded your position.
Don't reach out.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，挡了我的路线。
lines.en: You're standing on my route.

lines.zh: 我判断你不是我的目标。
lines.en: I judge you are not my target.
My engine is heating up.
Are you going to speak to me?
You take a step back, I take one forward.
The shell is dented; internals are fine.
I sway once and brace my feet.
A joint makes an abnormal sound.
My indicator flashes twice.
Damage logged.
One leg responds slowly now.
A little coolant is leaking.

lines.zh: 小型机甲的陀螺，重新归零。
lines.en: The tiny mech's gyro resets to zero.
It isn't pain; it's a warning.
I can still carry out the task.
I don't consume organic matter.
Food has no effect on me.

lines.zh: 你举它的动作没有意义。
lines.en: Raising that accomplishes nothing.
Put it away.
That's not usable fuel.
My power reserve is still sufficient.
You're attempting to bribe me.
I have no response to that.
That battery, I could use it.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞上了我的头。
lines.en: Your knee hit my head.
I'm pushed back one step.
There's no gap left between us.
One kick sends me two blocks away.
My shell took a small dent.
I keep balance and don't fall.

lines.zh: 你被我的棱角刮了一下。
lines.en: You caught yourself on my edge.

lines.zh: 我绕不过去，只能等你让。
lines.en: I can't get past; I need you to move.

lines.zh: 这一下两边的损伤都记下了。
lines.en: Both sides logged damage from that.
I've seen one of my model, once.
We exchanged a burst of signal.
It carries one more plate than I do.
No mating; only coordination.
We stand back to back.
Its number is higher than mine.
We split the area.
It doesn't answer my call.
Two small silhouettes stand abreast.
When the job ends, we part.
This metal can be salvaged.
I pick up a single screw.
Parts are mine. Inventory plus one.
I lift it with a clamp.
Material logged.
Too heavy; I'll drag it back.
Anything dropped must be logged.
It's worth a little alloy.
My little wheels start to accelerate.
I lock my lens onto you.
Range is now effective.

lines.zh: 我的腿上膛一样弹了一下。
lines.en: My leg snaps like a loaded spring.
Not a target, but in the way.
I'm cutting to your flank first.
Target holding still. Good.
I have marked your position.
Weapons unlocked.
I'm starting the count.
Your speed is below mine.

lines.zh: 这一带已经被我划进去了。
lines.en: This zone is already inside my assignment.
No verbal warning is required.
Thrusters lit.
I've closed three approaches.
Executing now; hold still.
I hold two paces off your flank.
You turn slower than I do.

lines.zh: 我在等你的护甲出现缝隙。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a gap in your armor.
I'm holding the firing line.
Your steps are getting heavier.
I'm moving to your right.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸频率我算好了。
lines.en: I've calculated your breathing rate.
I've shortened the safe gap.

lines.zh: 我躲进你靴子的阴影里。
lines.en: I hide in the shadow of your boot.
I approach from below knee height.
Target has not disengaged.
Beginning second scan pass.
Your weight is going left.
There's no cover here.
Coolant at seventy percent.
Awaiting optimal angle.
I ram with my whole chassis.

lines.zh: 我的撞击集中在一个点。
lines.en: My blow focuses on a single point.
You wobble from the impact.
My edge tears the cloth.
Not heavy, but accurate.
My joint jabs you.
A second strike follows.
A dent in your leggings.
I press in at your feet.

lines.zh: 这一击按预定轨迹完成。
lines.en: That hit followed the planned path.

lines.zh: 我的引擎短促地响了一声。
lines.en: My engine barks once.

lines.zh: 目标承受了第一次打击。
lines.en: Target has taken the first blow.

lines.zh: 我从运输舱的残壳里出来。
lines.en: I come out of a transport pod's shell.
The indicator lights, and I'm up.
My sensors start out blank.
This area is unmarked.
I take a stance and record the coordinates.

lines.zh: 推进器吐出一小股热气。
lines.en: Thrusters vent a small breath of heat.
My number is still on my chest.
The task is still in memory, unchanged.
I begin scanning the boundary.

lines.zh: 风把灰吹到我的镜头上。
lines.en: Wind blows dust onto my lens.

lines.zh: 我的第一个动作是校准。
lines.en: My first action is calibration.
Temperature over limit; I withdraw.

lines.zh: 落地冲击让缓冲器失效。
lines.en: Landing impact blew out a damper.

lines.zh: 水进了电路，我动作变慢。
lines.en: Water reached the circuits; I've slowed.
Blast pressure peeled my shell open.
Shrapnel is lodged in an armor seam.

lines.zh: 这种能量不在我的协议里。
lines.en: This energy isn't in my protocols.
Power has dropped below the safe line.
Overload; my circuits all flared.

lines.zh: 没有重力，我的陀螺仪失准。
lines.en: No gravity; my gyros are off.
